'''Jaanu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]]-like minion of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She wielded twin [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]]. Jaanu was defeated by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the inter-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an conflict which raged<ref name="CSWE" /> between [[22 BBY/Legends|22]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaanu was mentioned in the [[2008]] reference work ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
